name: SurgeDM
author: SurgeDM contributors
description: Surge download status, controls, and user-service power switch in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Download status, add downloads, and start or stop the Surge user service.

schema.label: Surge executable
schema.description: Executable name on PATH, or an absolute path.

schema.label: Host
schema.description: host:port or URL. Empty auto-detects the local server.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget polls Surge.

schema.label: Download directory
schema.description: Absolute path for downloads added from the panel. Empty uses Surge's own default; a relative path is rejected.

schema.label: systemd user unit
schema.description: Unit name the panel's power switch starts and stops, e.g. surge.service.

schema.label: Show service controls
schema.description: Turn off for a manually managed or remote Surge server.
